query: One ADQL query per object to NED TAP (sync): SELECT prefname, ra, dec, z, zunc, prefphytype, z_bibcode FROM NEDTAP.objdir WHERE prefname = '<name>'
extraction: Concatenated raw NED TAP CSV rows, values unmodified.
note: SUPPLEMENTARY ONLY. Positions and redshifts for the 40 kinematically confirmed PRGs are already carried by yu2026_table1_confirmed_PRGs.tsv, which took them from NED. NED prefname matching is exact and the TAP service was intermittently slow/queued during acquisition, so an unresolved name here means either a name-spelling mismatch or a service timeout, NOT that the object is unknown to NED.
